video_title: LeBron to the Warriors?! Biggest NBA Trade Rumors + Jaylen Brown to Philadelphia | Cousins

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James should consider joining Steph Curry and Jimmy Butler
quotes.excerpt: if this is last year, why not go team up with Steph, Jimmy Butler
quotes.quote: If this is last year, why not go team up with Steph, Jimmy Butler. You are talking about a rock star, a studded team in season everywhere they go. Steph Curry, LeBron, Jimmy Butler. My guy, to end your career with Steph Curry, why not?

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Atlanta's OBL championship win and Jaylen Brown's performance
quotes.excerpt: Atlanta had something on their mind, they came with it

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: We had eight cities. As you stated, you and Raleigh got put out in the first session, but y'all still are involved in OBL. We had a tremendous turnout, July 1st for the championships where it was the final four: Miami, DC, Baltimore, and Atlanta. And when I tell you, the favorites was DC to win it. But man, Atlanta had something on their mind, they came with it. I love the competition and how those guys just really went at each other. My man Paul from Atlanta with great shot creation and tough shot maker, he hit the game winner, a fadeaway three-pointer.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: And I want to say, well also, Jaylen Brown mentioned in the beginning in our Zoom call, he came out and said, 'Hey, when my team win, I'm matching the pot.' And everybody was like, 'Shoot, shoot.' So, who came out and said, 'Shoot, what if we win?' And he was like, 'Yo man, but what if DC wins? You going to match it for us?' And so it was just a great time, man.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Joel Embiid's health is the biggest question for the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: can he be healthy is the biggest question
quotes.quote: You have to look at Joel Embiid's case really hard and really dissect if he is healthy because everything is quiet right now. We don't hear no noise around him. We don't know what is going on with his health. And we know when he is healthy, he is one of the best. That is not a question. But can he be healthy is the biggest question. And that I don't know.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: The 76ers have a strong roster but need health to succeed
quotes.excerpt: I look at them being in the finals, I don't care what nobody say
quotes.quote: You got three guys that offensively they are elite. Defensively, they could be elite together. And it is just how we roll it out with the big fella. If he is healthy, oh shoot, I look at them being in the finals, I don't care what nobody say. If Joel Embiid is healthy, put it on the board. Philadelphia in the finals for me.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: The 76ers need sacrifice from their stars to win
quotes.excerpt: the biggest thing that needs to happen with this team is sacrifice
quotes.quote: The biggest thing that needs to happen with this team is sacrifice. You see what I'm saying? Because I feel like V.J., you know, his feelings, especially at the end of the year, how they were playing. You move on, you win in Boston Game 7, we had, we talked to him, you can see the confidence in him through that series, how uncomfortable he is feeling. I just hope that they can figure this out in the summer. I feel like they get in the gym work together and obviously working together and playing in the season is totally different. But it is a sacrifice and understanding at times it is going to be one of the four of you. It is going to be your time sometimes it is not. But you are a valuable weapon as a number four because of who will be guarding you.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's trade to the 76ers was a surprise
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen Brown was on a stream the other day, he reached out to Maxey, he talked to V.J.
quotes.quote: Jaylen Brown was on a stream the other day, he reached out to Maxey, he talked to Maxey and he talked to V.J., but I don't think he hasn't spoken to Embiid yet. And you know they had their thing in past years, personal thing going on. Now they are teammates and I don't think there's been a conversation between the two, at least not to my knowledge. I haven't heard anything on it. So, that's not a good sign because when you go into a new team, you go into a team that this is the MVP, like you've been the MVP for this team, now I'm coming to join your team and we haven't had a conversation. That's not a good sign.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul George's role in Boston and the team's future
quotes.excerpt: Paul George is now there in Boston. What happens to Boston now?
quotes.quote: Paul George is now there in Boston. What happens to Boston now? They gave Klay his money. What do you do with Peyton Pritchard? Do you put him in your starting lineup or do you utilize him as your weapon, your Jamal Crawford, your sixth man, your guaranteed, your Mano Ginobili type guy as you keep him as your sixth man to come in for your reliever? For me, I would keep him as the sixth man. I think he obviously he is comfortable in every role. Starts, he does well. He comes off the bench, right? It is he is a guy that adapts to any situation that he is in. But for me, I think coming off the bench is his specialty. I think he adds scoring for your team when there is lows, and you know they have their lows because they shoot a lot of threes. He is a guy that actually puts the ball on the floor and is a great shot creator. So, I think I will keep him at as the sixth man.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: The Celtics' regular season win total and the Eastern Conference
quotes.excerpt: I think the top four teams in the Eastern Conference all are going to win 50 games
quotes.quote: I'm going to say yes, because I think the top four teams in the Eastern Conference all are going to win 50 games. I think you are going to have to win 50 games to get into that top four. The East is going to be good this year, bro. Really good.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: The Celtics' roster is not complete yet
quotes.excerpt: I feel like their roster is not complete
quotes.quote: That's hard to answer right now because I feel like their roster is not complete. I want to know what that that shooting guard, who is at number two that you are going to add to your starting lineup? Because I I agree with you, the DeMar DeRozan. You need a you need another.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul George's proven ability and role in Boston
quotes.excerpt: Paul George is a guy that is proven, he is a guy that still going to go out there
quotes.quote: Paul George is a guy that is proven, he is a guy that still going to go out there and defend and he he can he can he can he is a catch and shoot guy. He still can get get his shot off and you know we it seems like when when we were in the building, we saw the best version of of of Paul George. So, I'm hoping he can bring that to Boston and give him the outlet.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: The Celtics need a backup center like Jonas Valanciunas
quotes.excerpt: I wouldn't be mad if you go get Jonas Valanciunas as your backup
quotes.quote: I wouldn't be mad if you go get Jonas Valanciunas as your backup. I think he brings to the table like we said he did for for Jokic. Yeah, that would be another guy, big fella who can rebound. He can but you can throw him the rock and he can score too.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Managing Jayson Tatum's minutes and the impact of his injury
quotes.excerpt: how do you manage his minutes when, you know, it was a situation with Wemby
quotes.quote: How do you manage his minutes when, you know, it was a situation with Wemby? When when we saw when Wemby goes off the out the game, is how much of a dip there is there. You know, those are questions I think that need to be answered this summer.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul George's performance against the Celtics in the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: Paul George did look good against the Celtics in the playoffs
quotes.quote: Paul George did look good against the Celtics in the playoffs. He looked amazing. He had a phenomenal series. Now if that Paul George can show up for a whole regular season, right? If he can do that for with 60, 65 games, now we talking.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Pritchard's role and value to the Celtics
quotes.excerpt: I think he is going to have a big role, I think he is going to have 28 points
quotes.quote: Peyton Pritchard is going to play a big role. I think he is going to have 28 points, man, and and that second team all NBA will should have been first team going off your roster. So it's a lot, a lot of, uh, slack to pick up.

quotes.quote: I think the top four teams in the Eastern Conference all are going to win 50 games. I think you are going to have to win 50 games to get into that top four. The East is going to be good this year, bro. Really good.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Lamar Odom's trade rumors and his impact on the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: there was a lot of talks about him being moved last year, year before
quotes.quote: There was a lot of talks about him being moved last year, year before. Like it was a lot of, a lot of talks about, particularly when he got benched. I think we talked about it on on TV a lot when he got benched. And that's where, you know, we started hearing a lot of noise about it, but then he bought in. And then things changed.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Lamar Odom's performance in the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: this past season was the season, his best season in terms of how many games he played
quotes.quote: This past season was the season, his best season in terms of how many games he played, like he was healthy for that season. If you look at his play, he kept the same, I would say style of play, but he kind he kind of dialed it back a little bit in terms of like it was controlled, it was controlled to where he got other guys involved and they got the possessions that they needed for them to to improve as a as a team. So that started with him, you know what I mean? And that probably came from the benching.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: The Lakers' trade for Lamar Odom
quotes.excerpt: if I pay you 280 million dollars, what do you think Lamar Odom is looking at Magic
quotes.quote: If I pay you 280 million dollars, what do you think Lamar Odom is looking at Magic or looking at that signing? Are you serious? Are you serious? You just gave him 280 million dollars. Y'all see what I did to him in the playoffs? You saw that, right? So, nah, man. I like Lamar Odom, but he ain't 280. Hell no, he can't get supermax. Get your money, but supermax is crazy. That is that's going to put Detroit in a bad situation, man.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' potential to join the Warriors
quotes.excerpt: I would love to see LeBron with Steph Curry and Jimmy Butler
quotes.quote: I know LeBron is playing with a lot of greats. I would love to see that on his way out. If this is his last season, I would love to see LeBron with Steph Curry and Jimmy Butler and just see the fandom and everything that comes with that. I think that would be great. Go out that way, bro. Forget what everybody else is saying, man, go play with Steph, bro, and ride that one out.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Defensive pressure forced adjustments in playoff series
quotes.excerpt: Their defense forced us to do that because it was like so many people.

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: But look, their defense forced us to do that because it was like so many people. So it forced—I know in my mind where it got to the point where I knew if I had—I was the best back in the day, we were posting up. I would post up, and I see the double—oh shoot. But it got to the fact where I caught it, I was trying to go before, just because I knew it was on the way. And then sometimes you look, third guy there.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: Green, green, green, green. That was their call. Green, green, green. I'm like, it's a third guy there.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Mental frustration and adjusting to playoff intensity
quotes.excerpt: Not getting so mentally frustrated and lost into the lack of success.

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: Like you said, controlling your breathing, but not getting so mentally frustrated and lost into the lack of success. Because like for us, like you said, we used to do all right against this team and against this player in the regular season. And then you see it's another level. And so you go through Game 1, like, all right, cool. They give you a different look with the same type of intensity in Game 2. And I agree with you, like you said, the second time around, all right, slow down. Let me recognize the defense.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: And it's not like we didn't study. It's not like we weren't prepared. It's just you got to go through it. You just got to go through it.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Importance of mid-range shooting in playoff basketball
quotes.excerpt: The mid-range is there. Take the mid-range.

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: That second time around is like, okay, I don't have to go take another dribble. The mid-range is there. Take the mid-range.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: You start seeing those openings and understanding. You can't just think get to the basket because they're collapsing and they're going to hit you, bro. And those playoff fouls, they're a little bit harder.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Reflecting on playoff battles against all-time greats
quotes.excerpt: These are giants, bro. These are like the greatest of all time.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: Just going back on your 2001 playoff against the giant like AI, facing him in the playoffs, and then me going up against Dirk in 2005. These are giants, bro. These are like the greatest of all time and we were competing against these dudes.

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: It doesn't get any better than that in the level of basketball, the competition of basketball.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: The pressure of responding after a 50-point game
quotes.excerpt: I remember after playing AI dropping the 54 and I'm going home that night.

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: Think about that for you. Like you just said, the response for me. I remember after playing AI dropping the 54 and I'm going home that night and I'm sitting there like, hey, bro. And you're reading the paper, reading the paper, hearing the news more so than social. And it's like, what you going to do? Like what you going to do? Like how you respond to it? And I was like, dang, bro. I got to.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: And I just remember coming out that game when I had the 51 or whatever and response I was like, this is what I got to do.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: The necessity of being aggressive in playoff series
quotes.excerpt: It's a must. You must. You got to answer that.

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: It's a must. You must. You got to answer that. I got to try. It got to be aggressive. There ain't no okay feeling. I get got. No, not this one. And that man had 54. Like, I got to, you know. And he's like, oh, okay, checkmate. And he had the response. And that, bro, it was just it was one of the greatest battle and greatest moments.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: People talk about basketball and the feeling of like, what's it like, bro? I can't even explain it.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: The mental zone required for playoff success
quotes.excerpt: I felt like I was in that mode the entire playoffs because I had to be.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: Okay, that moment right before jump ball. You dap up a little bit, but it's like, all right, I'm about to, you know, it's you're locked in.

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: No, it's yeah, I'm coming at your ass. Because I got to, I got to respond. There's no if, ands, buts. I got to respond because I I'm on the same court with you and I seen what you did. I have that ability, but I got to, especially at that time, because it was like T-Mac, Houston Rockets, it was T-Mac, Orlando Magic.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: The feeling of being unstoppable in a playoff game
quotes.excerpt: The feeling that you have, it just feels like you have your superpowers on you.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: People don't understand, when you knock down a couple of those threes in a playoff game, especially at home, bro, the feeling that you have, it just feels like you have your superpowers on you. Like you you just ate your spinach and your superpowers is on you and you can't be stopped.

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: Powered up. Yeah. You powered up and you can't be stopped. No matter what y'all do, I can hit any shot on this basketball court right now. Y'all asses are in trouble.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Evaluating the potential of rookie Darren Peterson
quotes.excerpt: Darren Peterson has shown like he's going to be that guy.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: Now we have the rookies coming in. Have you been impressed with some of the rookies that we've seen so far? I mean that you know just drafted that we've seen like the A-cup like there Michael Brown had a great showing. Darren Peterson has shown like he's going to be that guy.

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: No, he's him. I've been watching him since he was in the eighth grade, man. That he he got it.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Darren Peterson's poise and work ethic
quotes.excerpt: He's so poised and just he's confident. He works on his craft.

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: All the stuff they're saying about DP, he he he got it, bro. He's so poised and just he's confident. He works on his craft. He's a a gym rat. His head is on straight. I think the his his outlook on the game is what you want out of a young, you know, player that's coming into this league.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: And he's very capable of having those Dylan Harpers type of moments.
